credit: Mines, presses & wrecks: OXREP (Wilson & Friedman; Marzano & Flohr; Strauss) · Fish-salting: Motz 2021 (ODbL), Wilson 2007 · Wreck positions: MAPS 2020 (CC BY-NC-SA)
about: Archaeology. The model's silver, gold and copper come from the mining districts of the OXREP Mines Database (551 mines; Spain is over-represented because it is best catalogued), and its garum from the fish-salting workshops of Motz's 2021 dataset, weighted by vats. The OXREP presses (which don't record oil or wine) and Strauss's shipwrecks of c. AD 100–300 are shown as evidence to lay against the model: do the wrecks lie on its busy sea lanes?
